user.description: Choose the thermometer to set up. It must be switched on, within range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, and not connected to the ThermoPro app.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}? Home Assistant will keep the Bluetooth connection while it is switched on, so the ThermoPro app cannot connect at the same time.

abort.no_devices_found: No new thermometers found. Switch it on, close the ThermoPro app, and try again.

init.description: Applied the next time Home Assistant connects to the thermometer.

data.fahrenheit_display: Show °F on the thermometer's own display (off for °C)
